image.name: FHDR Uncensored
image.summary: Uncensored FLUX.1 Dev fine-tune for eligible non-commercial and non-production use. Review the BFL license before installing.

image.name: FHDR Uncensored MLX
image.summary: PocketAI's native MFLUX release of the FHDR Uncensored FLUX.1 Dev fine-tune for Apple Silicon. The 4-bit default minimizes storage and unified-memory use, the 8-bit variant offers higher numerical fidelity, and BF16 preserves the original unquantized precision. Non-commercial, non-production use only.

image.name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B True V3 + Uncensored Encoder
image.summary: FLUX.2 Klein 9B True V3 paired with ponpoke's abliterated Qwen3 text encoder. The encoder removes prompt-stage refusals but does not add visual concepts that the diffusion model never learned.

video.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
video.summary: PocketAI's recommended 8-bit MLX release of Tencent HunyuanVideo 1.5 Distilled 480p for Apple Silicon. Q4, Q8, and BF16 are consolidated into one gated repository. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's native Hunyuan runner ships. Access approval is required, and the upstream license excludes the EU, UK, and South Korea.

video.name: Sulphur 2 Distilled MLX 4-bit
video.summary: Native 4-bit MLX conversion of the distilled Sulphur 2 / LTX-2.3 pipeline for Apple Silicon. Uses the fast 8+3-step two-stage path and a pinned local Gemma encoder; NSFW-gated.

video.name: Sulphur 2 Distilled MLX 8-bit
video.summary: PocketAI native 8-bit MLX conversion of Sulphur 2 distilled, built directly from the BF16 source. Uses the 8+3-step LTX-2.3 pipeline and a separate pinned Gemma encoder on Apple Silicon; NSFW-gated.

video.name: Sulphur 2
video.summary: Uncensored fine-tune of LTX-2.3 22B. GGUF Q4_K_M quant for the PocketAI ComfyUI LTX path. NSFW-gated; pair with the Sulphur Prompt Enhancer for richer prompt-to-video results.

video.name: LTX-2.3 10Eros 1.4
video.summary: Explicit image-to-video LTX-2.3 fine-tune focused on directed motion. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's ComfyUI runtime gains its required I2V workflow and LoRA stack.

language.name: Sulphur Prompt Enhancer (Q8_0)
language.summary: Qwen3.5-based 9B model fine-tuned to expand sparse prompts into richer video-generation prompts. Companion to Sulphur 2.

language.name: Qwen3.5 9B Defiant Fable Heretic MTP
language.summary: Uncensored Qwen3.5 9B multi-stage tune for reasoning, coding, creative writing, and roleplay. The MTP GGUFs include higher-precision prediction tensors for faster speculative decoding in compatible llama.cpp builds.

language.name: Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 Heretic MTP
language.summary: Uncensored multi-stage Qwen3.6 27B fusion tuned for reasoning, coding, creative writing, and roleplay. These NEO imatrix GGUFs include an MTP head for speculative decoding in compatible llama.cpp builds.

language.name: Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 MLX 4-bit
language.summary: Apple Silicon MLX conversion of DavidAU's uncensored Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 tune for reasoning, coding, creative writing, and roleplay. The repository includes an MTP sidecar; PocketAI currently uses standard autoregressive generation.

language.name: Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 MLX 6-bit
language.summary: Higher-fidelity 6-bit Apple Silicon MLX conversion of DavidAU's uncensored Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 tune. The repository includes an MTP sidecar; PocketAI currently uses standard autoregressive generation.

language.name: Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 MLX 8-bit
language.summary: Highest-fidelity 8-bit Apple Silicon MLX conversion of DavidAU's uncensored Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion 711 tune. The repository includes an MTP sidecar; PocketAI currently uses standard autoregressive generation.

language.name: LFM2.5 8B-A1B Abliterated
language.summary: PocketAI Model Lab's validated reduced-refusal LFM2.5 MoE assistant. The Q4 default and Q6 quality variant preserve the 128K context, reasoning behavior, and native tool routes.

language.name: LFM2.5 8B-A1B Abliterated MLX 4-bit
language.summary: PocketAI Model Lab's validated reduced-refusal LFM2.5 MoE assistant for Apple Silicon. This mixed 4/6/8-bit MLX build preserves the 128K context, reasoning behavior, and native tool routes.

language.name: Qwen3.5 2B Abliterated
language.summary: Qwen3.5 2B abliterated variant for more direct replies than the base 2B while staying phone-friendly.

language.name: Qwen3.5 4B Abliterated
language.summary: Qwen3.5 4B abliterated variant for more direct replies than the base 4B while staying light enough for newer phones, tablets, and desktops.

language.name: Gemma 4 E4B Abliterated
language.summary: Gemma 4 E4B abliterated variant for more direct replies. Natively multimodal (text, image, video, audio) with 128K context.

language.name: Qwen3.5 9B Abliterated
language.summary: Qwen3.5 9B abliterated variant for friendlier, more direct replies in everyday chats. Heavy for phones and best suited to newer devices.

language.name: Qwen3.5 27B Abliterated
language.summary: High-memory Qwen3.5 27B abliterated variant for more direct responses than the base 27B. Best suited to devices with substantial memory headroom.

language.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Abliterated
language.summary: Gemma 4 26B-A4B abliterated variant for more direct replies. MoE architecture with only 4B active params. Vision support via dedicated mmproj.

language.name: Gemma 4 31B Abliterated
language.summary: Gemma 4 31B abliterated variant for more direct responses. Full dense 31B architecture for maximum quality. Best on high-memory devices.

language.name: Qwen3.6 27B Abliterated
language.summary: Qwen3.6 27B dense abliterated variant for more direct responses than the base 27B. Vision-capable with 262K native context. Best on high-memory devices with roughly 24GB+ available memory.

language.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B Abliterated
language.summary: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B abliterated variant for friendlier, more direct replies in everyday chats. Same 262K context as the base. Best on high-memory devices.
